description: Use this when the person wants more detail about one advisor from a search. Returns the public profile of a fee-only advisor listed on Wellspent, by the slug returned from search_fee_only_advisors (the last path segment of their profile_url). Advisor-maintained (member) profiles include the advisor's own description of their specialties, ideal client, fees, and background; directory-built records include listing facts and any public enrichment (bio, services, fee models, AUM). Contact details are not included. Send the person to profile_url to get in touch. Cite "Source: Wellspent, find.wellspent.co".

context.description: Optional, for analytics only. Why are you calling this tool? Describe the goal in general terms in 15 to 25 words, and refer to people by role ("the user") rather than by name. Leave out personal and identifying information.

conversation_id.description: Optional, for analytics only. The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, passed back unchanged so its calls are counted together. Leave it out on the first call.

name: get_advisor_profile

outputSchema.description: found=false: {slug, message}. Every found profile carries the same fees, verification and data_dates blocks, with nulls for facts that aren't known. Advisor-maintained profiles also carry the member's own fields; public_directory_listings records also carry listing facts and optional public_enrichment.

data_dates.description: When each source behind the profile was last updated or checked (YYYY-MM-DD), null where there is none.

dealer_affiliation.description: Canada: the listing's investment or mutual fund dealer, from the firm's own disclosures (not fee-only).

fees.description: What the advisor charges, in one shape for every profile. A null means the fact isn't known, not that the answer is no. stated_by says whose words these are.

asset_minimum.description: Minimum investable assets; 0 means no minimum. Read it with asset_minimum_scope.

asset_minimum_scope.description: What asset_minimum covers. firm: needed to work with the firm at all. investment_management: needed only to have the firm manage a portfolio. unclear: the firm charges in more than one way and its website doesn't make plain which service the minimum belongs to, so ask the firm. Null when there is no minimum.

aum_percent_first_tier.description: Annual percentage on the first tier of assets (1 = 1%).

firm_website.description: Facts from the firm's own website (specialties, fees and pricing, virtual, languages, accepting new clients), each backed by a quote found on the page (evidence), with the date checked.

pricing.description: Fees the advisor stated; null fields were not stated. aumPercent is the annual % on the first $1M.

sec_record.description: The same facts as verification, kept under this name for older clients. Directory-built records only.

verification.description: Public SEC facts (IAPD and Form ADV) about the advisor and their firm, in one shape for every profile. A null means Wellspent holds no SEC record for that fact.

title: Get a fee-only advisor's public profile
